maria: bringing up HF model 'lexa-mini' via hf->redwood convert tool and hitting a weird combo of failures. safetensors shards download sometimes 403, and when it succeeds keys are renamed (ckpt.module.* -> model.*) but converter only applies rename for full single-file models. result: missing weight keys and tokenizer special tokens get lost.

leo: can you paste the converter log and the small stack?

maria: gist: ```
INFO: convert: starting conversion rev=main pin=true
INFO: hub: downloading shard 1/3 -> 200 OK
INFO: hub: downloading shard 2/3 -> 403 Forbidden, retrying
WARN: hub: retry succeeded but partial shard -> wrote 0 bytes tempfile
ERROR: converter: weight key rename map mismatch, missing keys: ['transformer.h.0.attn.q.weight']
ERROR: tokenizer: additional_special_tokens dropped: ['<|user|>', '<|assistant|>']
```

dana: ugh. two separate issues: 1) hub auth/edge token expiry causing transient 403 on shards (we've seen CDN edge expiry on large models), and 2) weight-key-rename logic in convert-tool is only applied for single-file flow. it doesn't apply when safetensors are in shards with index -> rename map lost.

sam: +1. also saw a config.json quirk: model had "add_bos_token": false and chat_template used assistant_role='assistant_id' (nonstandard key). our importer normalizes expected keys but misses custom chat_template fields, so special tokens end up not being set on the Tokenizer object. that explains the dropped special tokens.

leo: can you try run again with HF_RETRY_AUTH=1 env and attach HF CLI logs? also try convert with --apply-rename-map-explicit flag I just pushed to a temp branch.

maria: trying now. one more wrinkle: we ran post-convert quantization (ptq->4bit) and eval shows quality regression on our summary benchmark (~6 ROUGE pts). not sure if missing token mapping or quantization introduced it. running baseline unquantized to compare.

build-bot: started job 9843: convert-lexa-mini (branch: leo/rename-fix).

deploy-bot: shard-download: retry 2 -> 200 for shard 2/3

maria: convert succeeded with leo's flag and HF_RETRY_AUTH=1, tokenizer now has special tokens set, weights present. running eval now.

sam: for the quantization regression, try 'preserve_input_embeddings' and run eval with exact same prompt sets — often tokenizer mismatch causes tokenization drift that's amplified after quant. also check if convert stripped metadata 'tokenizer_config.json' that has "clean_up_tokenization_spaces": false.

maria: good catch — the convert step overwrote tokenizer_config.json when shards were partially applied earlier. fixed that by re-merging original tokenizer_config. re-ran q4: still ~4 ROUGE pts down vs FP16 baseline.

leo: possible causes: 1) quantization candidate kernels (kproject) behave differently for rotary/rope scales, 2) key rename inadvertently changed parameter grouping (e.g., layernorm.* -> ln.*) and per-layer scale mismatch at quant time. can you dump a few norms / max abs before/after quant?

maria: dumping now. snippet: ```
fp16: ln0.weight.abs().max() = 12.3
q4->dequant: ln0.weight.abs().max() = 12.28
fp16: attn.q.weight.abs().max() = 6.2
q4->dequant: attn.q.weight.abs().max() = 6.19
```

sam: numbers look close. that suggests tokenization drift or chat template mismatch is likely the main driver. try eval with raw tokenized reference (no re-tokenization) to isolate.

maria: ran raw-token eval — discrepancy drops to ~1.2 ROUGE. so it's tokenization/chat_template mapping. looks like convert still normalized a few chat template keys and we lost a per-turn prefix in templates (assistant_prefix -> became assistant_role). short-term fix: patch convert to preserve unknown chat_template keys and emit warning.

leo: I'll open a PR to: 1) make converter apply rename map for shard flows, 2) preserve tokenizer_config.json merge semantics, 3) preserve unknown chat_template keys. tagging @dana for hub auth fallback telemetry too.

dana: thanks. I'll also add a small retry wrapper in our download client to detect 403->200 patterns and do a verify-checksum step for partial tempfiles.

maria: thanks all — saved the model bring-up. leaving notes in model-onboarding doc and will rerun full eval after PR lands. :tada:

leo: awesome. cc @eng-ml if anyone else sees lexamini oddities.
